observations: 27/36 baseline threshold passes become18/36; nominal9/9 becomes6/9. All12 reverse cases finish but fail only stop_displacement.
The22/17 common-full comparison has28 pairs, not the25 used in the prior21/17 comparison. MeanJ improvement is sensitive to one old reverse60 outlier; reverse0..40 all nine pairs deteriorate.

Actual negative/positive translation tick exposures are balanced in16,18zero,22. Both directions are guaranteed within each completed paired translation course; first-sign probability is not direction tick probability.

Lower LR and shorter budget improve some yaw/survival observations and substantially reduce logged local KL versus18, yet do not retain baseline reverse parking. LR alone has not resolved the objective.
22 reverse is faster and moves farther after command removal; this differs from21 reverse undertracking. Neither a direction-sampling cause nor a shared identical failure mechanism is established.
inferences_and_limits: First-order reverse-start frequency and stop-context duration differ; they are possible distribution details, not proof of forgetting through forward oversampling.
Training reward uses instantaneous tracking and standstill velocity/yaw terms, not the formal cumulative stop-displacement threshold. Good per-phase training rewards need not certify the latter.
LR is one-third and added budget one-quarter of18; their joint change prevents an isolated LR causal estimate.
Continued training on zero delay has not shown full delay robustness. One policy per training seed does not establish training-seed significance.

limitations: Read-only audit of existing results only. No repository changes, model loads, inference, simulator/physics steps, training, tests, or execution of existing script main functions.

No whole-corpus trajectory metrics were recomputed. Metrics and J values for all 36 pairs come from existing formal/report.json; only six representative reverse NPZ files were previously read with NumPy for descriptive window statistics.
The common-full set has 28 pairs under the declared completion criterion. A 25-pair count is not supported by the observed matrix.
Completion and threshold pass differ. A 600-tick full-horizon case can fail stopping or posture thresholds and remains in the primary common-full comparison.
The all-36 mean J includes a fixed 100-point penalty on each early failure and is strongly affected by differing early-failure counts.
The common-full mean is strongly affected by the old full-horizon reverse60 seed1003 case. The exclusion result is an explicitly labeled one-case sensitivity analysis.
The 3-to-8 and 4-to-7 second NPZ windows are descriptive audit windows, not a claim to reproduce the evaluator stable-window definition.
NPZ velocity samples are indexed by policy_interval_start_s; they are interval-result records rather than an independent continuous-time measurement.

The representative reverse trajectories support overspeed and larger backward stopping displacement as observed behavior; they do not identify a causal training-loss, learning-rate, architecture, or implementation mechanism.
One trained policy per run and three reset seeds per scenario do not establish multi-training-seed statistical significance or deployment qualification.
closeout17 protocol.json has no explicit sequences field. Exact equality of protocol sequence dictionaries was not asserted; matrix keys, reset_info, backend, thresholds and budgets were checked.
72 NPZ byte SHA checks and formal report/protocol artifact-map checks were performed earlier in this same audit and are reused while serializing this file, with no repeat full NPZ read.
